Coerce to a dribble

Source: R/dribble.R
as_dribble.Rd

Converts various inputs into a dribble. This is how every protondrive function interprets its file and path arguments:

  • A dribble is returned as is.

  • A character vector is treated as paths and looked up with pd_get().

  • A character vector marked with as_id() is looked up by ID.

  • A data frame with the columns of a dribble is validated and converted.

Usage

as_dribble(x, ..., call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

x

An object to coerce.

...

Not used.

call

The execution environment of a currently running function, used in error messages.

Value

A dribble.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
as_dribble("reports/q3.csv")
as_dribble(as_id("vol...~node..."))
} # }
